engineChanges.title: A result atom in the shared evaluator

atom.qualifiers: <optional: the fact model's own qualifier keys, e.g. fastingState, challenge, specimen>

semantics: Reads the latest non-superseded observation fact for the concept THAT MATCHES THE QUALIFIERS, at or before the note time. A later random glucose must not hide an earlier fasting one.

Qualifier names and values in this pack ('fastingState: fasting', 'challenge: ogtt_75g_2h', 'specimen: capillary') are placeholders. Phase 0 maps them to MS-DATA-CFC-001 section 4.1; no second vocabulary is created.

HbA1c: the atom is UNKNOWN for a diagnostic rule while a blocking validity caveat holds (pregnancy, HIV on ART, a haemoglobin variant, haemolysis, recent malaria or transfusion, iron or B12 deficiency, eGFR below the reference) or the method is not a certified laboratory method. The matrix still shows the value, marked 'not usable for diagnosis' with the reason; a restricted reason is shown only in views that hold that class.
TRUE or FALSE only when a fact exists inside max_age and at or above min_trust; otherwise UNKNOWN. Unknown never satisfies an atom and never counts against a diagnosis.
Both bounds may be given (a band).
The evidence matrix shows the value, its date, its age in days and the trust badge.
A restricted concept can never be evidence on a standard diagnosis (existing check.ts rule).

engineChanges.why: Gap 3 of the briefing: HbA1c, eGFR, UACR and laboratory glucose cannot be evidence today.
engineChanges.tests: Both ways for every rule that uses it; an empty record stays silent; an out-of-window result is unknown, not false.

engineChanges.title: Per-condition detail in Past history
engineChanges.where: data/clerking/clerking-history-catalogue.v1.json past_history.condition_details; lib/clerking/answers.ts HistorySchema; compose.ts; a new atom past_detail

rules: Shown only when the condition is answered yes.
Uses the existing property kinds (one, many, year, text) and phrase grammar.
Nothing is charted from these answers: they are note text and evidence refs ('pmh:diabetes#type'). The problem-list proposal carries them as qualifiers for the clinician to confirm.

engineChanges.why: Gap 2: Past history is a bare yes/no with 'since'.

engineChanges.title: A context qualifier on the glucose vital atom

rules: One vocabulary: the values the vital already stores. The laboratory result atom (EC-1) uses the fact model's qualifiers; the two are mapped once, in code, and tested.
A capillary value is never read against a venous 2-hour threshold: the capillary threshold has its own reference (REF-DX-GLU-2H-DM-CAP).

engineChanges.why: vs.glucose already stores a required context. A fasting threshold must not fire on a random value.

engineChanges.title: A signed suggested-care list for the Plan
engineChanges.why: Suggested care is empty until a signed list exists. A ticked item is stored as plan.problems[id].care[itemId] = true, which the schema already allows.
rules: 'opens' adds to the basket; it never overwrites a disposition or follow-up the clinician has already set.
An item with min_age_ref is hidden below that age; an item with max_age_ref is hidden at or above it.
'due: later' items create a follow-up task, not a test in today's basket.

refs_dm is provenance for the dossier and is ignored by the clerking sign-off; the references that gate a rule are the REF-EX and REF-DX entries, which are generated from the dossier and never typed twice.

engineChanges.title: A pregnancy atom
engineChanges.where: lib/clerking/exam/context.ts evalCond; the pregnancy episode in the fact model

rules: 'unknown' when the patient could be pregnant and nobody has recorded the answer.
Results offered as evidence on a pregnancy diagnosis are bounded to the current pregnancy episode.

engineChanges.why: Without it the two pregnancy profiles cannot be gated, a pregnant woman with a fasting glucose of 7.0 is offered the wrong diagnosis, and the statin and ACE inhibitor items cannot exclude pregnancy (review G10). Both pregnancy profiles and DDX-PREGNANCY-GLUCOSE are withheld until it exists.

engineChanges.title: Glucose entry: units, and readings that are not numbers
engineChanges.where: vs.glucose in the exam catalogue and the vitals form

fields.unit: mmol/L | mg/dL (converted by the platform, stored in mmol/L with the entered unit kept)

rules: HI satisfies every 'at or above' glucose atom; LO satisfies every 'below' atom. No number is invented for either.
A plausibility range, signed as a reference entry, rejects a mg/dL value typed as mmol/L.

engineChanges.why: The two most dangerous meter readings cannot be recorded today, so every rule is silent for the sickest patients at meter-only sites (reviews F25, G17).

engineChanges.title: Smaller evaluator and catalogue additions this pack uses

history: shown_when and includes_any on a history property
a per-condition composer that omits any clause whose property is unanswered
exam: the vs.ketones panel and its save path
panel atoms: {panel, field, gte_ref|lt_ref|any_of} and {panel, recorded}
two classifiers (ketone_band, dr_review); classifiers live in code, so these are specifications to implement, not data to load
diagnosis: setting as a list in a DDX rule
plan: patient age atoms min_age_ref and max_age_ref
item keys refs_dm, ncd_step, where_unavailable, due
formulary: a ketone row on the glucose chart

engineChanges.why: Each was used by the first draft without being declared (review G18). Any that Phase 0 finds already present is struck from this list; any the owner declines removes the rules that depend on it, which the catalogue check then reports.

engineChanges.title: What 'amend' means in a catalogue amendment
engineChanges.where: the loader for data/clerking/*.amendment.json (new), or by hand in Phase 2

rules: _op 'add' creates a new entry and fails if the id exists.

_op 'amend' MERGES: listed atoms are appended to suggest_for, suggest_against, ask and tests_to_decide if not already present; scalar fields are changed only where the amendment lists them under '_changes'. Nothing is removed.
The six diabetes profiles marked 'amend' were written without sight of the live profiles. Phase 0 produces a per-profile diff against the live catalogue for the CSO; nothing is applied blind.

engineChanges.why: 'Replace' would wipe signed content, for example the live dx.ckd profile (review G11).
